integrated_multimodal_description:
<Reference frame: <Picture 1> is a real frame captured from this exact shot of the original footage. It is the authoritative reference for what appears in frame - reproduce its camera framing, shot size, subject placement, subject count, wardrobe, hairstyle, props, lighting and colour faithfully. Do not redesign the shot. The reference frame may show one soft, defocused patch where an overlay used to be; render it as ordinary continuous background texture - never as characters, boxes, bars, plates or panels. >

<Cast and blocking - exact, this must be preserved:
Exactly THREE people are visible in this shot, staged at clearly different depths: one in the foreground (largest, seen from behind or cropped by a frame edge), the speaking subject in the middle ground (sharpest, face roughly 22% of the frame area), and one further back, smaller and partially occluded. They must not form a flat row. 
Universal blocking rules, apply for the whole shot:
- Keep the reference camera position, lens, shot size, camera height and subject distance exactly. Never push in, zoom, recentre or reframe. A group shot must stay a group shot - never turn it into a single-person close-up and never single out one face for a portrait.
- Keep the exact number of people given above. Do not add anyone who is not in the reference and do not drop anyone who is in it; no bystanders, no extras, no mirrored or reflected figures.
- Do not line people up shoulder to shoulder in a flat horizontal row at equal distance from the camera, and do not stack them into a symmetrical wall of faces. Stagger them in depth and vary their scale the way the reference frame does.
- Every visible person keeps a separate, fully formed head with their own distinct facial features, hairstyle, clothing and skin tone. Never merge, fuse, blend or duplicate faces, and never let one person's face melt into another's or into the background.
- Every face stays clearly resolved - separated eyes, nose, mouth and jawline - even when small or in the background. No smeared, mushy, waxy, indistinct or half-formed faces.
- Do not enlarge any face beyond its reference size; do not shrink faces into unreadable specks.>

<Action and camera for this shot - stage it exactly as written, once, and let it complete:
- Action: Zhao tears open a soy sauce bun and squeezes its filling into a sizzling wok; a spoon stirs as steam rises sharply This action must be visibly underway inside the shot and reach its end before the shot cuts. Do not hold a static pose, do not freeze halfway, do not repeat or mime it.
- Camera: camera slowly pushes in while shifting focus from the hands to the pot. One continuous move only; no cut, no whip, no snap zoom inside the shot.
- Any dialogue is carried on top of this action, not instead of it; the body keeps working while the mouth moves.
>

<Scene: 厨房灶台，烟火气>

<Shot: 近景 (MS-), cinematic 9:16 vertical framing, 50 mm lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic live-action footage, the shot runs the full 3.750 seconds>

<Performance: 老赵 delivers the line; the mouth movement is driven strictly by the supplied reference audio and stops the instant the audio goes quiet. Keep natural micro-expressions and small continuous body motion; never freeze into a still frame.>

<Style & frame constraints - apply to the whole shot, every second of it: cinematic 9:16 vertical framing, ARRI Alexa look, fine film grain, true-to-life East Asian skin with visible pores, fine lines and a matte finish, neutral white balance, muted naturalistic colour, gentle filmic contrast with a soft highlight roll-off. No oily sheen and no glossy specular highlights on any face, no beauty-filter smoothing, no airbrushing, no waxy or plastic skin, no HDR glow, no bloom, no over-sharpening, no over-saturated colour, no orange or teal colour cast, no heavy vignette, no digital gloss or plastic AI sheen. No subtitles, no captions, no burned-in titles, no lower-thirds, no text banner or bar across the frame, no on-screen text, no watermark, no logo, no timestamp, no UI overlay. Never imitate or reproduce a subtitle strip or any text overlay from the source material; do not add any floating or superimposed lettering of any script - Chinese, Latin, digits or symbols - anywhere in the frame. Any paper, sign, plaque, package or printed surface in frame is blank or shows only soft unreadable blurred marks.>

[00:00.000 - 00:03.750] The shot holds the reference framing continuously; 老赵 delivers the line; the mouth movement is driven strictly by the supplied reference audio and stops the instant the audio goes quiet. Subtle handheld breathing and continuous ambient motion throughout.

strict_output_constraints: Absolutely no subtitles, no captions, no burned-in text, no on-screen text of any kind, no watermark, no logo, no timestamp, no UI overlay, no lower-third. Any sign, plaque, paper, lettering, package or printed surface appearing in frame must render as completely illegible abstract marks - no readable characters, digits or words in any language whatsoever. Text-bearing props are set dressing only and must never be legible. Speech is driven only by the supplied reference audio; do not render any mouth shapes for lines that are not audible.
